description: van't Hoff model with kinetics-based sorption rate and lumped thermal balance
source: Sandrock (1999) J. Alloys Compd. 293-295; Lototskyy et al. (2014) Prog. Nat. Sci.; Mayer et al. (1987) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy

delta_H.note: Enthalpy of hydride FORMATION (absorption, exothermic, negative). Sandrock 1999: LaNi5 dH_abs = -30.1 kJ/mol

delta_S.note: Entropy of hydride FORMATION (absorption, negative). Sandrock 1999

H_max_wt_pct.note: Maximum gravimetric H2 capacity for LaNi5

kinetics.note: First-order kinetics: dm_H2/dt = Ca * exp(-Ea/RT) * ln(P/P_eq) * (C_max - C) for absorption

Ca_abs.note: Pre-exponential rate constant for absorption. Mayer et al. (1987) Int. J. H2 Energy

Ca_des.note: Pre-exponential rate constant for desorption. Mayer et al. (1987)

Ea_abs.note: Activation energy for absorption. Mayer et al. (1987)

Ea_des.note: Activation energy for desorption. Mayer et al. (1987)

cp_hydride.note: Heat capacity of LaNi5H6. Herbst & Hector 2005

UA_bed.note: Overall heat transfer coefficient * area for bed cooling
